# PerchTV 0.1.9

Holding a skip key now moves much faster, and the waiting screen looks after the panel.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Hold left (or ⏪) or right (or ⏩) to move 5 minutes a second, in either direction. A tap is still 10 seconds back or 30 forward. Films and episodes only; live channels are unchanged.
- While paired and nothing is playing, the waiting screen moves to a new place every 5 minutes and fades to black after 30, so a panel left on all evening does not burn in. From there the television's own sleep takes over. Any remote key, or casting something, brings it straight back.
- The pairing-code screen stays put and never goes black, so the code can always be read.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing, casting from the phone, play/pause and stop, the 0.1.8 screensaver fix, and the update check on every start.
